From interfaces and APIs to data, real-time systems and retrieval — I like owning a product end to end and shipping it.

## What I build

- **Frontend systems** — Responsive product interfaces with clear state. <sub>React · Next.js · TypeScript</sub>
- **Backend & APIs** — Auth, business logic and reliable REST services. <sub>Node.js · Express · REST</sub>
- **Data layer** — Schemas and storage shaped around the product. <sub>PostgreSQL · MongoDB · Prisma</sub>
- **Real-time** — Live messaging, presence and event-driven UX. <sub>Socket.IO · WebSockets</sub>
- **AI & retrieval** — Grounded retrieval and media-intelligence pipelines. <sub>Python · Embeddings · Vector search</sub>
- **Shipping** — Repeatable builds and production delivery. <sub>Docker · Vercel · Render</sub>
